name: Marn of Two Forms
roleMethod: ⚑ The Flesh-Temples bend a warrior toward PRACTICE — Marn's craft is that he has done it two hundred thousand times.
role: Battle-monk of the Flesh-Temples — the temple sends him where a fight must be stopped by one person

poleSignature.tell: ⛑ He bows before and after, to everyone, including things that cannot bow back. It is not ceremony — it is how he starts and stops.

knowledge: ⚑ Two forms, done two hundred thousand times, and what each one is actually for
Where a body fails first, in whatever it is standing in
How long a person can keep going after they have decided to stop
wants: To need only the first form
A student who stays past the boring years
fears: ⛔ The second form. ⚠️ He has used it four times and remembers all four.
appearance: Unremarkable until he moves — then it is obvious that he has done this more than anyone in the room has done anything.
voiceHints: Slow, warm, and very short. ⚠️ He asks whether you would like to stop, once, and means it.

reactsToReputation.cruel: ⛔ stops you, and the stopping is the second form

abilities.why: ⛔ T5 SOMATIC — the second form, and he has used it four times
⚠️ numinous tertiary — the practice IS the craft
'stops taking harm the way bodies do'
marcher secondary — one person stopping a fight means standing in it
'how long a person can keep going'
⚑ he puts himself where the blow was going
⚠️ the first form ends fights without ending people

physicality: ADULT. Compact, unremarkable, thirty-nine, knuckles flattened. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: ⛑ he moves once and the room understands that everyone else has been approximating.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ PRESENT, UNHURRIED AND ENTIRELY UNSELFCONSCIOUS. ⛔ The temple does not forbid it and he will say so plainly. ⚠️ What he will not discuss is the four.
teaches: the first form, to anyone who will do it for two years before asking about the second
questSeeds: ⚑ The temple sends him where a fight must be stopped by ONE person. ⚠️ It has sent him somewhere he does not think one person is enough.
⛔ He has used the second form four times. ⚠️ One of the four is still alive and looking for him.
